intro: A plate of pulut kuning with rendang is about 550 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the santan-cooked pulut and the oily rendang.
diet: Yes, especially at kenduri or Hari Raya. Pulut is denser than rice, so even a little is high in calories. Take one scoop of pulut and focus on the meat. Then keep your next meal light.
tips: Take half the pulut and more rendang meat.
Go easy on the oily rendang gravy.
Add some vegetables or cucumber on the side of your plate.

swap.name: Half pulut kuning with rendang and cucumber
swap.why: You still get the raya feel, but save about 160 kcal.

faq.a: The colour comes from turmeric mixed in when soaking or steaming the pulut.

faq.q: When is pulut kuning usually served?
faq.a: Usually at kenduri kesyukuran, weddings, akikah and Hari Raya.

faq.q: How long should I soak the pulut?
faq.a: Most recipes soak it at least 4 hours or overnight so it cooks evenly.
